site: Gale Crater — lower Mount Sharp flank
citation: USGS Astrogeology / MSL — HiRISE DEM mosaic of Gale Crater, 1 m/px, v3
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 50 deg
resolution_note: source product is 1 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 1.17188 m/px spans 1200 x 600 source posts and is sampled at 1.17x the source spacing — no interpolated detail is claimed
layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
note: Rocky uphill traction. 1 m/px HiRISE, the finest Mars DEM there is.
